landing_subtitle: AI-Supported English for Academic Purposes Learning and Teaching System
landing_lead: The EAP Platform connects classroom teaching, autonomous learning, academic skill development, homework submission, feedback, and learning analytics through a calendar-centred digital environment.
student_page_lead: Check your progress above, then use the calendar to open a day and work on tasks.
teacher_page_lead: Choose your class, then pick a date on the calendar to manage that day's tasks, uploads, and submissions.
api_note: API — start Flask before signing in. Open the hosted UI (port 5051) so login cookies work.
